answer.book: Progymnasmata in Ioannis Fernelii Medici librum De abditis rerum causis (Basel, Henricpetri, 1579), a commentary by Jacques Aubert: front matter (dedicatory epistle, prefaces, elenchus) followed by fifty-two numbered exercitationes, each disputing one question raised in Fernel's work.
